1.why: The UI uses a clean sans-serif typeface with clear letter spacing and comfortable line spacing across all screens.

2.why: Instructions use sentence case with no italics, all-caps, or dense text blocks.

3.why: The centered single-column layout with ample whitespace appears readable and well suited to a mobile viewport.

4.why: Copy such as “Enter the six-digit code delivered to your verified mobile number” is short and plain.

5.why: No example or placeholder showing the expected format of email, phone, or verification code is provided.

6.why: Every screen contains only brief sentences; the user never faces a long text block.

7.why: No long codes or secrets are displayed with a copy control; the six-digit field must be typed manually.

8.why: No QR code or equivalent alternative to manual entry appears on any screen.

9.why: Standard text inputs are shown that might allow autofill, but no explicit password-manager or autocomplete support is visible.

10.why: Page headings name the current step and the blue primary button stands out clearly.

11.why: Each screen asks for only one main action (Continue or Verify identity).

12.why: A log notes that delivery was initiated, but after actions the UI does not plainly state success or the next step.

13.why: The user can retry after an error, yet no control to re-request or reveal/hide codes is offered.

14.why: The message “We could not complete that request. Please try again” does not explain the problem or how to fix it.

15.why: No countdown or time limit is shown on any screen, though a backend timeout cannot be ruled out.
